notes: Added API exposure, facade integration, and E2E validation coverage for explainability layer.

change_log.note: End-to-end test coverage for explainability in chat flow

stories.title: Expose Explainability via Evaluate Care API
stories.description: Extend evaluate care API responses to include standardized explainability objects alongside evaluation signals, ensuring consistent contract delivery to frontend.

stories.title: Facade Integration of Explainability Layer
stories.description: Integrate explainability builder into evaluate_care_facade orchestration so all provider and clinical trial responses include mapped explainability fields before returning to chat layer.

stories.title: End-to-End Explainability in Chat Flow
stories.description: Validate that explainability metadata flows from backend services through facade and is rendered correctly in chat responses, including mixed provider and clinical trial scenarios.

stories.title: Explainability API Contract Tests
stories.description: Implement tests to validate that API responses always include schema-compliant explainability fields (source, meaning, limitations) and adhere to Pydantic model definitions.
